{bu,fg=accent}Fixing the pagination bug{/}

The test in {fg=code}./orders{/} fails because {b,fg=code}List{/}
computes the offset from a {i}zero-based{/} page,
but pages are one-based: page 1 skips the
first {fg=code}size{/} rows. See {u,fg=info}the handler{/}
{fg=dim}(https://example.com/orders/list.go){/} or
{u,fg=info}https://example.com/docs{/}.

{b,fg=info}What changed{/}

{fg=dim}* {/}{fg=code}offset := page * size{/} became {fg=code}(page - 1) *{/}
  {fg=code}size{/}
{fg=dim}* {/}a guard for {fg=code}page < 1{/}:
  {fg=dim}1. {/}return an error
  {fg=dim}2. {/}or clamp to 1
{b,fg=good}[x] {/}test added
{fg=dim}[ ] {/}changelog entry

{i,fg=quote}> Note: pages stay one-based in the API.{/}
{i,fg=quote}> Only the SQL offset changes.{/}

{fg=faint,bg=slab}| {/}{i,fg=dim,bg=slab}go{/}{bg=slab}                                        {/}
{fg=faint,bg=slab}| {/}{bg=slab}func (s *Store) List(ctx context.Context, {/}
{fg=faint,bg=slab}| \{/}{bg=slab}page, size int) ([]Order, error) {       {/}
{fg=faint,bg=slab}| {/}{bg=slab}    offset := (page - 1) * size           {/}
{fg=faint,bg=slab}| {/}{bg=slab}    return s.query(ctx, offset, size)     {/}
{fg=faint,bg=slab}| {/}{bg=slab}}                                         {/}

{b}page{/} {fg=faint}|{/} {b}offset{/} {fg=faint}|{/} {b}rows{/}
{fg=faint}-----+--------+-----{/}
1    {fg=faint}|{/}      0 {fg=faint}|{/}  50
2    {fg=faint}|{/}     50 {fg=faint}|{/}  50
3    {fg=faint}|{/}    100 {fg=faint}|{/}  12
